respuesta.razonamiento: The diagram displays two ingestion pipelines at Expedia Group feeding into downstream analytics/reporting (Salesforce Einstein Analytics): a batch ETL processing pipeline using S3, Glue, and EC2, and a real-time streaming pipeline using ECS (running a Kafka consumer), Aurora, Lambda, and SQS. All visual boxes map cleanly to AWS and third-party services. Generic mentions in narration like 'APIs' and 'other Lambdas' are abstracted by the drawn line from SQS to Salesforce.
respuesta.nombre: Expedia Group - Batch and Streaming Ingestion to Salesforce Einstein Analytics
